announcements.title: Codex Accounts Manager 0.1.21-l8 — Relay fallback and billing
announcements.summary: More resilient sharing recovery, account priorities, and GPT-6.2 usage pricing.
announcements.content:
This stable local build adds the l8 sharing recovery and local usage updates.
1. An optional user-level SSH fallback can recover Relay polling after repeated transient network failures without replaying uncertain writes.
2. Seamless switching honors the manual priority queue across eligible quota capabilities and preserves temporarily filtered entries.
3. Local usage estimates include GPT-6.2 Sol and GPT-6.2 Astra, including cached input and dated model names.
4. Existing multi-device sharing state and reload-safe account handling remain unchanged.

zh.title: Codex Accounts Manager 0.1.21-l8 — Relay fallback 与计费改进
zh.summary: 共享链路恢复、账号优先顺序，以及 GPT-6.2 用量价格。
zh.content:
本稳定本地版本新增 l8 的共享恢复与本机用量改进。
1. 可选的用户级 SSH fallback 会在 Relay 临时网络连续失败后恢复轮询，不重放结果不确定的写请求。
2. 无感切号在合格的额度能力之间统一遵守手动优先队列，并保留暂时被筛选排除的队列项。
3. 本机用量估算新增 GPT-6.2 Sol 和 GPT-6.2 Astra，支持缓存输入与带日期后缀的模型名。
4. 保留现有多设备共享状态和 reload 后的账号恢复行为。
